summary: Bullish, a Cayman Islands-domiciled digital asset platform listed on the NYSE, filed a Form 6-K on July 31, 2026, announcing its intention to release Q2 2026 financial results on August 13, 2026, along with an earnings call. The press release also discloses fully diluted outstanding shares of 160,673,515 at a Q2 average price of $34.77 and 159,641,222 at the June 30, 2026 close of $23.43. This is a routine earnings-schedule announcement with no special-situation elements, no M&A activity, no strategic review, and no unusual corporate action. The filing is purely informational regarding a future earnings release, constituting ordinary course disclosure.
